items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had a bassist named James Legrange.

ctx.x: You mean at your level of ideas?

Yes, at my level certainly. I’ll agree with that. There were several musicians who wanted to, but they just couldn’t hang with us [laughs]. We had a bassist named James Legrange. He was from Cleveland. And a drummer named -- if I can think of his son. His son is a well-known trumpeter. He’s from Indianapolis. Whitted. Farris Pharez Whitted is the trumpet player, a young trumpeter. His father was the drummer in my --
